results.id: L|Package\Update Standing Order First Transaction Received|detail
results.detail: Units 1, 3, 4 and 5 are correct. Unit 2 describes the bank-account comparison only as 'zero-padded to 12 digits'. The SQL is right('0000000000000' + x, 12) on both sides (DTSX:3992). Values longer than 12 characters are also cut to their last 12 characters, so two different account numbers with the same last 12 characters would match, and a NULL account number never matches. The 'detailed' claim shows the exact expression, but this plain-language unit leaves the truncation out. Minor wording point in unit 4: 'statecode אינו משתנה' is proven only in the sense that the code does not set statecode (main.cs:126-129). The runtime result depends on CRM platform behaviour and on the external CRM.Proxy, which are not in the files. The open-question claim words this correctly as 'not set in the code'.

wrongUnits.problem: The account match is described as zero-padding to 12 digits only; the right(...,12) truncation of longer values is omitted.
wrongUnits.correct: Both account numbers are prefixed with 13 zeros and the last 12 characters are compared: shorter values are zero-padded, longer values are cut to their last 12 characters; NULL never matches.
